# r4 — Transactable

## What this measures

Can an agent actually *do* commerce here — open a checkout, call a tool, ask
a question? This is the module where shape matters more than status: agents
parse fields, not vibes. A stub that answers 200 with a non-canonical body
scores as reachable but not canonical.

Note the path trap the probe encodes: ACP uses `/checkout_sessions`
(underscore), UCP uses `/checkout-sessions` (hyphen). They are different
protocols with different status enums.

## Sub-checks

| Sub-check | Pass when | Weight | Fix skill |
|-----------|-----------|-------:|-----------|
| ACP checkout surface | `OPTIONS {api_base_url}/checkout_sessions` answers as an API surface (POST allowed, or non-404 status that is not a catch-all 200 text/html) | 1 | `acp-agentic-commerce:acp-checkout-rest` |
| ACP create session *(deep)* | POST demo cart → 200/201 or ACP-shaped error `{type,message}` | 2 | `acp-agentic-commerce:acp-checkout-rest` |
| ACP canonical CheckoutSession *(deep)* | `object=="checkout_session"`, `status` ∈ enum, top-level `line_items[]`, non-empty `totals` | 2 | `acp-agentic-commerce:acp-checkout-rest` |
| ACP version echo *(deep)* | response echoes requested `API-Version` (header or body) | 1 | `acp-agentic-commerce:acp-capability-negotiation` |
| UCP checkout surface | `OPTIONS {rest endpoint}/checkout-sessions` answers as an API surface (not 0/404/3xx, not a catch-all 200 text/html) | 1 | `ucp-agentic-commerce:ucp-checkout-rest` |
| UCP canonical session *(deep)* | POST → `status` ∈ UCP enum / `line_items[]` / `messages`, or a protocol-shaped 4xx error `{type,message}` | 2 | `ucp-agentic-commerce:ucp-checkout-rest` |
| MCP tools/list | JSON-RPC `tools/list` (a pure read — always sent) → 200 with `jsonrpc`/`result` | 2 | `ucp-agentic-commerce:ucp-checkout-mcp` |
| NLWeb /ask | endpoint answers as an API surface (deep: 200 with JSON/SSE content-type and results/answer) | 1 | `nlweb-protocol:nlweb-ask-endpoint` |

Deep rows carry weight 0 in shallow mode ("skipped") and never lower a
shallow score. The MCP endpoint is resolved from the UCP profile's
`services` map (per-transport bindings) before falling back to `/mcp`.

## Safety note (deep mode)

Deep POSTs are discovery-shaped (demo SKU, no payment method), but on a live
merchant a created session can still trigger inventory holds or
abandoned-cart emails. That is why `--deep` is opt-in, mirrors an
idempotency key, and should be pointed at a staging host when one exists.

## N/A condition

A non-commerce site with no checkout intent.

## Fix guidance

Implement one binding fully before adding a second. REST first
(`acp-checkout-rest` / `ucp-checkout-rest`), then MCP (`ucp-checkout-mcp` /
`acp-checkout-mcp`) — the MCP binding reuses the REST core.
